issues.title: Playing Bracca together can break or get out of step
issues.body: Bracca played as co-op is still buggy: the two games can drift apart, and story moments may not line up.
issues.workaround: The host can set BRACCA to Skip, or to Each on your own, before starting the journey.

issues.title: DUEL or HOST JOURNEY says LOCKED
issues.body: Duels need the Duelist role and journeys need the Journey role in the Jedi Co-op Discord. Without the role, that entry is locked.
issues.workaround: Apply with /apply tester. Once you're approved it unlocks within about 5 minutes. Make sure you're signed in with Discord in the launcher.

issues.title: The Second Sister's opening scene can start at different times
issues.body: When you reach the Second Sister together, her opening cutscene can start for one of you a few seconds before the other.

issues.title: Spiders can keep appearing during a cutscene
issues.body: On Dathomir, spiders kept appearing for one player while a cutscene played, and a large group was waiting when it ended.

issues.title: The game doesn't pause in co-op
issues.body: Opening the menu doesn't pause the game in co-op: the world keeps running for both of you.
issues.workaround: Open the menu somewhere safe, away from enemies.

issues.title: A cutscene can start for one of you before the other
issues.body: When you're together, cutscenes now start at the same moment for both of you. When you're apart, each of you sees them when you get there.

issues.title: The lift on Bogano could kill you partway up
issues.body: Riding the lift at the Great Divide no longer kills you partway up.

issues.title: A rope shortcut one of you opens may stay closed for the other
issues.body: When either of you cuts a rope shortcut down, it drops for both of you.

issues.title: Enemies led away from their spot may not show up for your friend
issues.body: Enemies your friend leads away are where they left them when you get there.

issues.title: A boss's health can refill when one of you dies
issues.body: Bosses keep the damage you've done when one of you dies, and fight the player who comes back.

issues.title: Chests give both of you the same cosmetic
issues.body: With "Own chest cosmetics", chests give each of you a different item.

issues.title: Your friend's poncho can look like a different one
issues.body: Your friend's poncho shows in the right style from the moment they join.

issues.title: A controller can't pick a journey under YOUR JOURNEYS
issues.body: With a controller, D-pad down now reaches your saved journeys on the Join screen.

issues.title: You may not hear an enemy that's fighting your friend
issues.body: You hear the enemies that are fighting your friend.

issues.title: You couldn't parry blaster shots aimed at your friend
issues.body: Shots fired at your friend are now real in your game too: you can block and parry them where you see them.

issues.title: Co-op could stop after the host respawned or rode a lift
issues.body: Co-op no longer stops for the rest of the session after the host dies and respawns, or rides a lift.

issues.title: The game could crash when some enemies came into view
issues.body: With some enemies, such as Purge troopers, the game could close without warning when they came into view during co-op. This is fixed.

issues.title: Shortcuts your friend opened stayed shut after you rejoined
issues.body: When the host had opened a shortcut in an earlier session, it stayed shut for a joining player. Shortcuts the host has opened are now open for you as soon as you join.

issues.title: Force Slow looked different in your friend's game
issues.body: Slowing a puzzle object with the Force now looks the same in both games.

issues.title: Enemies got tougher every time a player rejoined
issues.body: With Tougher or Toughest, enemies no longer gain extra health each time a player leaves and joins again.
